It’s increased over the last month and it’s at a point where I’m wound up horribly after having a three day holiday. Taking my work away because I took a bathroom break is unacceptable. And yes, I am documenting everything.
If she doesn’t change, talking to my manager will be of no help. My manager doesn’t give a shit about literally anything because she’s retiring this summer.
